dedupe_keys.name: trafic des routes departementales de loire atlantique

description: Trafic des routes départementales de Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Trafic annuel et trimestriel des voitures et des poids-lourd sur les routes départementales de Loire-Atlantique. Le trafic est calculé selon deux méthodes de comptage qui sont: Les comptages permanents: le Département possède 43 stations de comptages fournissant des données de type horaire en TV (Tous Véhicules) et PL (Poids-Lourd). Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are déplacement, voirie départementale, véhicule, trafic, poids lourd, comptage. The portal shows 1,921 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
